items.title: ChatGPT Wallet — OpenAI's agents can now buy things for you
items.summary: OpenAI gives its agents a way to pay, with a one-time-use card token and your approval on every order.

items.title: llama.cpp v1.0.0 — first stable release, with semantic versioning
items.summary: The local inference engine behind much of open-model AI makes its first stable release and promises clear version rules.

items.title: Transformers v5.23.0 — LFM3, Inkling 2 and a rebuilt model export
items.summary: Seven new model types and a new export API land in Hugging Face's model library.

items.title: ZONOS3-Mini — Zyphra's open TTS model clones voices in real time
items.summary: An Apache-2.0 speech model small enough to clone a voice in real time on a phone or in a browser tab.

items.title: Brave Search API — AI agents can now pay per request with x402
items.summary: Brave Search API lets an AI agent pay for each search with a stablecoin, with no account or API key.

items.title: Codex CLI 0.169.0 — side-chat tabs, task search and collapsible turns
items.summary: Codex CLI adds tabbed side chats, task search, collapsible transcripts and in-terminal provider setup.

items.title: OpenCode 2.3.0 — subagents run in the background by default
items.summary: OpenCode 2.3.0 makes subagents non-blocking and trims the transcript down to a quiet activity row.

items.title: Daybreak Red Team and Defense Factory — OpenAI's agents test and patch apps
items.summary: OpenAI's Daybreak platform adds an agent pen-tester for web apps and an agent pipeline that fixes code flaws.

items.title: Self-hosted Claude Managed Agents — run the whole agent service in-house
items.summary: Claude Managed Agents can now run entirely inside a company's own network, with the model provider of its choice.

items.title: Claude Meetings — Claude joins video calls as a participant
items.summary: Claude sits in your video call, answers questions and builds docs and whiteboards while you talk.

items.title: Edge0-145B — an open 145B MoE model that runs on one consumer GPU
items.summary: Edge0 open-sources a 145B coding and agent model that fits a single consumer GPU.

items.title: Mirendil raises $1B Series A — ex-Anthropic lab building AI R&D agents
items.summary: Mirendil raises $1B to put frontier AI research tools within reach of more scientists and engineers.

items.title: Codex CLI 0.168.0 — side-by-side chats, audio clips and animated GIFs
items.summary: Codex CLI adds a split-pane workspace, audio input, animated GIFs and a model provider picker.

items.title: Checkpoint forensics — Chinese open models carry a Blackwell GPU fingerprint
items.summary: Random-number traces in published weights reveal which NVIDIA chip generation started a model's training.

items.title: smolmaxxing — a 16B MoE model runs on a 1 GB TV box and a 2013 iPad
items.summary: Per-chip kernels and experts paged from flash let 16B models run on devices with about 1 GB of RAM.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.323 — Code Mode lets Claude call its tools from JavaScript
items.summary: Claude Code 2.1.323 adds an experimental Code Mode in which Claude writes JavaScript to call its own tools.

items.title: Fireship — 'Nvidia just got caught with its pants down...'
items.summary: A Fireship breakdown of why Jensen Huang suddenly left Nvidia, the company that makes most AI training chips.

items.title: Google Intelligent Eyewear — Gemini glasses open for preorder from $395
items.summary: Google's first Android XR glasses put a hands-free Gemini assistant, a camera and live translation into normal-looking frames.

items.title: VS Code 1.146 — the Local agent harness is deprecated, Copilot harness stays
items.summary: VS Code 1.146 starts a three-month countdown to remove the Local harness and adds tools for managing many agent sessions at once.

items.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen — Google's fast, low-cost model for agent work
items.summary: Google's Gemini 4 Hydrogen is a cheaper, faster Gemini 4 model built to run the everyday work of coding agents.

items.title: Codex Security 0.10.0 — OpenAI's scanner can resume scans and cap costs
items.summary: OpenAI's open-source vulnerability scanner gets resumable scans, cost budgets and clearer patch failures.

items.title: Two Minute Papers — 'DeepMind's AI Just Did The Impossible'
items.summary: Two Minute Papers explains how DeepMind's AI agents proved that Signal's encryption code is correct.

items.title: A2UI 1.0 — Google's generative UI protocol reaches its first stable version
items.summary: Agents send a description of a screen; React, Flutter, SwiftUI and Compose apps render it with their own components.

items.title: ha-mcp 9.2.0 — the Home Assistant MCP server trends on GitHub
items.summary: Let an AI assistant write, fix and roll back your Home Assistant automations and dashboards.

items.title: ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview — Baidu's 280B MoE for agentic coding
items.summary: Baidu's 280B mixture-of-experts model with 14B active parameters, built for long agentic coding and office work.
